title.en: Kinetic typography stage with readable alternatives

summary: Animate authored words and phrases in 3D while preserving reading order, pause control, captions and a static text representation.
objective: Build a typographic performance where text motion serves the supplied script and every timed phrase remains available without motion or audio.
example_prompts: Stage a spoken poem as moving type, with synchronized captions, pause controls and a static transcript layout.
negative_signals: Not automatic transcription, universal reading-speed prescription, font licensing clearance or a required style.
not_for: No motion-only meaning, hidden transcript, uncontrolled flashing or redistribution of unlicensed fonts/text.

entities.name: Script tokens
entities.guidance: Store exact text, language, reading order, cue interval and optional speaker separately from meshes; preserve punctuation and a plain-text view.

entities.name: Type stage
entities.guidance: Blender may author reusable letter/word forms and anchors; runtime layout owns line breaking, focus, occlusion avoidance and fallback fonts.

state_contract.model: One immutable script revision contains ordered tokens and timed phrase intervals. At model time t, active text and transforms derive from cue data; a token never changes its textual identity because of animation. Pause freezes the timeline, seek rebuilds active phrases, and skip advances to a declared boundary. Provide synchronized captions for prerecorded speech, and controls or a presentation mode that pauses/stops/hides qualifying moving content. Static transcript and reduced-motion layouts preserve the same reading order and choices.
state_contract.authority: Three.js owns the versioned semantic state, model time, history and reset; Blender/glTF assets are named presentation resources only.
actions: Play/pause/seek or jump to next phrase.
Reset time, focus and view state.

invariants: Every visible glyph maps to one script token and reading-order index.
Motion cannot be the sole carrier of wording, speaker or interactive choice.
Pause and same-time seek are idempotent.
Missing font or 3D glyph falls back to readable text without losing content.
motion_guidance: Drive presentation from a seekable model time and derive every visible transform from current state; pause and scrub never advance hidden semantic state.
Provide a static sequence/list and reduced-motion mode that preserves text, order, choices and status.
creative_affordances: Choose typography, assets, palette, staging and metaphor per the supplied brief and licensed material; no house style is mandatory.
Blender owns expressive geometry, rigs, sets and cue anchors; Three.js owns time, branch/state, captions, interruption and checkpoints.
known_limits: Caption and motion controls are scoped to the supplied media/function; no one animation speed, typeface or layout is declared universally accessible.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no Blender export, audio playback, visitor study, show-control link, browser or renderer was run.

claims.statement: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 1.2.2 requires captions for prerecorded audio content in synchronized media except when the media is a clearly labeled text alternative.
claims.scope: WCAG conformance criterion for prerecorded synchronized media; this recipe retains a transcript additionally as authored support.

source_refs.locator: Understanding SC 1.2.2, Success Criterion and Intent

claims.statement: WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 2.2.2 provides pause, stop or hide requirements for certain moving, blinking, scrolling or auto-updating information, subject to its timing and essentiality conditions.
claims.scope: Only content meeting the criterion’s conditions; not a universal ban on kinetic typography.

source_refs.locator: Understanding SC 2.2.2, Success Criterion and Intent

object_craft.structure: Use generous depth separation, stable phrase anchors and a transcript panel; keep hit targets independent of glyph meshes.
object_craft.material: Maintain explicit foreground/background contrast and selection outline; decorative extrusion never obscures letter counters.

physical_contract.scope: Spatial layout and motion communicate authored media/state; geometry and collisions have no physical authority.
physical_contract.timestep: Evaluate from seekable authored time or discrete event state; no physics integration.
checks: presentation controls leave semantic data unchanged
